''' Cabin 523''' was a room in the [[Taupe Corridor]] on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Reasonable Doubt]]''. It used to be a storage closet but was converted into a room. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Maks Leem]] occupied the room during a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
